shared_clauses.text: receiving a machine-readable manifest that defines an addressable scope external to the manifest
determining that no active bounded processing node possesses a capability required to address the manifest-defined scope
constructing a bounded processing node having no greater addressability than required by the manifest
binding the processing node to a transition-table cell defining state, role, permitted input, permitted output, authority, refusal, succession, and expiry conditions
retaining the processing node after completion only while externally evidenced continued usage satisfies a delayed-expiry condition
preserving context associated with continued usage without expanding beyond the manifest-defined addressability
generating a receipt identifying the manifest, node build, exercised addressability, state transition, output, and expiry or retention disposition
forming a state-bearing heartbeat from current system state, prior subsystem information, context, and routing intent
evaluating health and admissibility of the heartbeat before subsystem interaction
determining a multidimensional delta between a source heartbeat and one or more returned subsystem signals
updating system state and subsequent routing according to evaluated fresh subsystem data rather than merely returning a reflected signal to its originating subsystem
providing a reconstructable representation of source, return, delta, and resulting state transitions to a witness record system
continuing observation until a manifest-relative complete signal is acquired or a minimum adverse-condition observation interval is satisfied
producing a non-inference result when the required observation interval expires without sufficient evidence
calibrating distinguishable sender-isolated, receiver-isolated, requested-coupling, confirmed-coupling, joint-operation, and disengagement states
invoking a manifest-specified node build only after observing a calibrated neural state satisfying an invocation condition

families.title: Transition-Table-Native Dynamic Micro-Node Computing
families.inventive_center: Demand-constructed, manifest-bounded processing nodes whose existence, addressability, transitions, context retention, and expiry are governed by a machine-readable transition table and evidenced by receipts.
families.technical_problem: Conventional static pipelines, agents, and distributed workers retain unnecessary capability, lack transition-bound authority, and cannot prove the exact addressability exercised during computation.
technical_effects: prevents unnecessary capability from remaining active
preserves context only for active use

implementation_evidence.description: Transition-table-native request, decision, receipt, deterministic verification, role-obligation, and portable installation implementation.
Demonstration of larger runtime adaptation around manifest-bound micro-node behavior.
Portable declarations, warrants, policy references, and witness structures relevant to node construction.

families.notes: Highest filing priority. Populate dates and claim-by-claim inventorship before external publication.

families.title: Heartbeat-Governed Entity and Reflected-State Computing
families.inventive_center: A composite state-bearing heartbeat that is evaluated before transmission, transformed by subsystem interaction, compared with returned signals, and used to update whole-system state, node construction, routing, recovery, and witness records.
families.technical_problem: Ordinary liveness heartbeats and telemetry do not expose relational subsystem health, transformation deltas, context-bearing state evolution, or the distance between non-inference and irreversibility.
technical_effects: observes source, path, receiver, and coupling health separately
uses return deltas to localize subsystem behavior
adapts observation and routing according to fresh subsystem data

implementation_evidence.description: Entity lifecycle and orchestration-cycle material relevant to heartbeat-governed state.
Continuity event, reconstruction, intake, export, and reporting mechanisms.

families.notes: Heartbeat health is determined prior to reflection; returned signals are primary evidence of relational and subsystem health.

families.title: Generalized Adaptive Scanner Using Dynamic Micro-Nodes
families.inventive_center: A generalized scanner that constructs acquisition, decoding, and comparative micro-nodes from observed signal conditions and evaluates an entity by how subsystems transform state-bearing inputs over a dynamically sufficient observation interval.
families.technical_problem: Fixed scanners and isolated-signal classifiers cannot efficiently reconstruct whole-system condition from simultaneous transformations, cross-signal coupling, adaptive response, and recovery.
technical_effects: allocates computation proportionally to detected signal strength and ambiguity
distinguishes adaptive fluctuation from dysfunction through comparative relationships
preserves non-inference where completeness is not reached
families.notes: Sensor modalities and organism-specific embodiments must be supported in the specification without making unsupported diagnostic claims.

families.title: Manifest-Governed Bidirectional Neural Communication
families.inventive_center: A calibrated mutual-state contract in which observed neural states invoke manifest-specified bounded node builds and stimulation or interpretation occurs only through transition-governed, mutually distinguishable isolated and coupled operating states.
families.technical_problem: Existing neural interfaces may decode or stimulate without a reconstructable mutual contract distinguishing spontaneous activity, intentional communication, authorized coupling, disengagement, and recovery to autonomous operation.
technical_effects: prevents uncalibrated neural activity from being treated as communication
requires reciprocal evidence before joint operation
preserves autonomous sender and receiver states
records when coupling began, changed, and ended
families.notes: Separate passive observation, interpretation, communication, and stimulation authority in all claim and embodiment data.

limitations.text: a manifest intake component
a capability resolver configured to determine whether an admissible active node can address the manifest
a constructor configured to instantiate a minimum-addressability bounded processing node when no admissible active node is available

claims.preamble: A computer-implemented method for evaluating a coupled system, comprising:

limitations.text: forming a state-bearing source heartbeat from current system information and prior subsystem data
determining source-heartbeat health before interaction with a receiving subsystem
receiving fresh subsystem data and determining a multidimensional delta relative to the source heartbeat
updating whole-system state and routing subsequent state-bearing data to one or more subsystems according to the evaluated fresh subsystem data
recording a reconstructable representation of the source, return, delta, and resulting state changes
a heartbeat composer
a subsystem return collector
a delta evaluator configured to compare state-bearing source and return data
a transition-governed routing component configured to form and route a subsequent heartbeat

claims.preamble: A method for scanning an entity, comprising:

limitations.text: acquiring a plurality of signals during temporally coordinated observation
dynamically constructing one or more signal-specific acquisition nodes according to normalized strength, noise, ambiguity, or confidence
constructing subsequent decoding or cross-signal comparison nodes according to attributes of acquired signals
determining functional condition from relationships among source-to-return transformations rather than solely from isolated thresholds
continuing observation until a manifest-relative complete signal is obtained or a minimum adverse-condition observation period is satisfied
producing non-inference when sufficient evidence is not obtained
a plurality of sensing modalities or channels
a temporal synchronization component
a transition-governed node constructor configured to allocate acquisition and analysis nodes according to detected signal conditions
a comparative state reconstruction engine

technical_effects: minimal compute proportional to observation need

claims.preamble: A method for bidirectional neural communication, comprising:

limitations.text: calibrating neural and system states that distinguish isolated operation from mutually acknowledged coupled operation
observing a calibrated neural state and invoking a manifest-specified bounded node build associated with the state
producing an interpretation or stimulation candidate within a transition-table-defined authority and safety boundary
requiring reciprocal confirmation before entering joint operation
generating a receipt identifying observed state, invoked node build, coupling state, output, and disengagement or recovery disposition

claims.preamble: A bidirectional neural communication system comprising:

limitations.text: a neural activity acquisition interface
a manifest-bound node constructor
a mutual-state transition controller
an optional bounded stimulation interface operable only in a permitted coupled state

technical_effects: separation of observation, interpretation, communication, and stimulation authority
